utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's on the repair drive? Is it the tool library?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think it's something like that—I heard Daria mention collecting tools for the community workshop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is Daria the one in charge of that?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools I can lend out if anyone needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's great, Gus! I think we're collecting things for the drive, yeah. I'll keep your tools in mind.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just let me know if you need a wrench set or a power drill, I've got both.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, really? That sounds nice, but I wonder how they're managing all the drop-offs and pickups—do we need to sign up in advance?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think you just bring stuff by the community center on Saturday morning, no sign-up needed—they'll take care of it on the spot!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, what's this about a repair drive? Need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at my place, in the garage. I could use some help organizing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Opal! I'm great at organizing tools. Let's head over to your garage and get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I did hear something about it. To be honest, I've been meaning to fix a few things around the house but... well, it's been tough lately.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I totally get that. But the repair drive could really help you out—neighbors helping neighbors, you know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm glad you're here. I wanted to discuss the upcoming repair drive—we have a lot of folks signed up to help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, what's the plan for the materials and tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I've compiled a list of what we need and some neighbors are donating supplies. Let's go over it together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Is this about the repair drive for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, sorry I'm late—yes, is that still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it's still on for Saturday at 10 AM. Did you need the address again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I was thinking about the repair drive. Do you know if the sign-up sheet is still open?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it's still open! I just saw it at the community center this morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll swing by after school pick-up to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard you were talking about a repair drive—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's a community event where locals bring in broken items—like appliances or bikes—and we help fix them up together. I thought it'd be a fun way for neighbors to connect.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like a great idea. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that—what's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going through with that? I thought that was just a rumor.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's real! I think we're collecting old electronics or something? I just signed up to drop off my stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, Oren. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think it's for fixing up the old playground equipment. Did you hear about it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I hadn't heard about it. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I heard about the repair drive this weekend. Are you thinking of going?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I was planning to go. I figure I can help keep an inventory of what parts folks bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So you'll be there helping with inventory, got it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, what's this about a repair drive? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yeah, I'm trying to gather tools for small fixes around the neighborhood. Any extra hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can help. When are you planning to get started?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Did I leave my tool kit somewhere again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, remember? We're fixing up old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Saturday! I'd better put a note on my fridge. Do we need any special tools?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Leo. What's this about a repair drive? I think I missed something.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We're collecting broken tools and appliances to fix at the community center next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it. So I just bring my old stuff to the center next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need me to bring some tools?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Gus, that'd be great. Bring any wrenches or screwdrivers you have, and meet me at my garage at 10 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I'll bring a good selection and see you at your garage at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, are you ready for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've been telling everyone about it. Need any help rounding up more folks?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great! Maybe we can put up a few flyers around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal! I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center on 5th Street. Flyers are on the bulletin board if you want to grab some!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I'll grab a few flyers and post them at the coffee shop and library. Let me know if you need any other help!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How's everything going?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa, it's going well. I've been tallying up the supplies we have so far—we're in good shape for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful news, Cleo! Do you have a list of what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what skills can you bring to the table?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm pretty handy with small electronics and I can sew, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush, just give me the highlights.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's a community event this Saturday where folks can bring broken items and we'll help fix them. Volunteers needed, especially for electronics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I might swing by if I can. Got any specific electronics you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're working on a repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Where'd you hear that?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I think I overheard you talking about it the other day. Sounded like a big project.
